questions.question_text: According to Section 1, what is an important element of writing a proper email to a teacher or coach?

options.text: Using slang and emojis to make the email friendly
Including a clear subject line and a formal greeting like “Dear Mr. Smith”
Writing a long, detailed message to explain everything
Avoiding a signature to keep the email casualCorrect Answer: B) Including a clear subject line and a formal greeting like “Dear Mr. Smith”

questions.question_text: Based on Section 2, what is a key tip for using video chat tools like Zoom or Google Meet during virtual classes?

options.text: Keeping your camera off at all times to stay comfortable
Joining on time, muting when not speaking, and engaging actively with the camera on
Multitasking by texting or browsing during the meeting
Using a distracting virtual background to stand outCorrect Answer: B) Joining on time, muting when not speaking, and engaging actively with the camera on

questions.question_text: What is a recommended practice for being respectful in online chats and school forums, as discussed in Section 3?

options.text: Posting in all caps to emphasize your point
Thinking before posting and using polite language like “please” and “thank you”
Sharing personal information about others to build trust
Responding immediately to every message, even if upsetCorrect Answer: B) Thinking before posting and using polite language like “please” and “thank you”

questions.question_text: In Section 4, what is a strategy for building a positive online image for future opportunities?

options.text: Posting controversial opinions to show personality
Auditing your social media to remove unprofessional content and sharing achievements like volunteer work
Keeping all profiles completely private to avoid scrutiny
Ignoring what comes up when you Google yourselfCorrect Answer: B) Auditing your social media to remove unprofessional content and sharing achievements like volunteer work

questions.question_text: According to Section 5, how can high schoolers manage screen time to avoid burnout from constant messaging?

options.text: Checking messages constantly to stay updated
Setting specific check-in times and using “Do Not Disturb” mode during homework or sleep
Keeping the phone in the bedroom at night for easy access
Avoiding communication apps entirely to reduce stressCorrect Answer: B) Setting specific check-in times and using “Do Not Disturb” mode during homework or sleep

questions.question_text: What is a general benefit of mastering digital communication skills, as highlighted in the chapter conclusion?

options.text: It ensures you’ll never face online misunderstandings
It prepares you for academic success and future opportunities like college and jobs
It eliminates the need for face-to-face communication
It guarantees a large social media followingCorrect Answer: B) It prepares you for academic success and future opportunities like college and jobs
